title: Proposal to Set Up Commission of Inquiry to Review Government's Response to COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Proposal to Set Up Commission of Inquiry to Review Government's Response to COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Future pandemic and after-action review
sections.summary: Another novel disease causing a global pandemic is a matter of when, not if, and a comprehensive after-action review will be undertaken.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Another novel disease that causes a global pandemic is not a matter of if, but when, and the next disease may well be even more contagious and dangerous than COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: So, we will certainly undertake a comprehensive after-action review (AAR).

sections.label: Full AAR timing
sections.summary: The full after-action review must wait until the situation has stabilised and Singapore is out of the woods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The full AAR will therefore have to wait until the situation has stabilised and we are out of the woods.

sections.label: Commission of Inquiry suitability
sections.summary: A Commission of Inquiry, a quasi-judicial investigative tribunal, is not the most appropriate way to achieve this objective.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: A Commission of Inquiry, which is a quasi-judicial investigative tribunal, is not the most appropriate way to achieve this objective.

sections.label: Adapted measures and broad-ranging AAR
sections.summary: Testing, ring-fencing, safe management and traveller procedures changed along the way, and the Government intends a broad-ranging after-action review on all aspects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: As you can see, our testing, our ring-fencing, our safe management procedures, our procedures for incoming travellers – all have changed and adapted along the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: We want to make sure that when we reach a new normal, this process is properly documented so that we are ready for the next round, just as we did not have a COI for SARS but we learnt many valuable lessons from it which allowed us to be better prepared for COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Section 3 of the Inquiries Act does say that "a Commission is suitable if an inquiry is to be conducted into any matter which in the opinion of the President be in the public welfare or public interest".

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The Government intends to do a very broad-ranging AAR on all aspects because there are many aspects to this particular pandemic from which we can learn good lessons for the future.
